atAGlance: Nước ép táo is a familiar café juice option, crisp and mild, useful when a traveler wants something simple on a Vietnamese drink menu.
whatItIs: Nước ép táo is fresh or café-style apple juice. Expect apple juice that is crisp, mild, sweet, and familiar.
howToEnjoy: Order it when you want a gentle fruit drink without strong tropical aroma.
howLocalsOrder: Nước ép táo is usually made or poured cold, so ask for no sugar, less sugar, or no ice before the glass is finished. Fresh fruit versions taste best when the flavor stays tart, pulpy, or fragrant.
worthKnowing: In Vietnam, Nước ép táo is more café-style than deeply traditional, but useful on mixed drink menus.
